item_name: Rothco Long Journey Canvas Travel Bag
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Long Journey Canvas Travel Bag is a versatile and durable travel companion, crafted from rugged 22oz unwashed cotton canvas to handle all your travel needs. The spacious main compartment features a U-shaped zipper opening, making it easy to access and organize your belongings, while 2 zippered side pockets and 2 front flap pockets offer additional storage for smaller essentials. Designed with style & durability in mind, the bag’s leather accents and brass hardware add a touch of sophistication.
description: Rothco’s Long Journey Canvas Travel Bag is a versatile and durable travel companion, crafted from rugged 22oz unwashed cotton canvas to handle all your travel needs. The spacious main compartment features a U-shaped zipper opening, making it easy to access and organize your belongings, while 2 zippered side pockets and 2 front flap pockets offer additional storage for smaller essentials. Designed with style and durability in mind, the bag’s leather accents and brass hardware add a touch of sophistication, ensuring you travel in style. For comfortable carrying, the bag includes an adjustable shoulder strap with padding and dual carry handles. Whether for a weekend trip or an extended journey, Rothco’s Long Journey Travel Bag provides the storage and resilience needed for your adventures. Made from Rothco’s durable heavyweight canvas fabric, this superior material is naturally water-resistant, rugged, and is built for the long haul. No one comes close to Rothco’s collection of ultra-premium canvas bags and packs.
